text:
Maya L: Quick sync — INC-834 postmortem actions. Can everyone confirm owners + firm due dates? Copying folks who were on the incident. TL;DR: we have 4 actionable items, need owners and canary plan.

Maya L: Action list from RCA:
```
A1: rollback safeguard + runbook updates -> owner: TBD, due: EOW
A2: autoscale policy tweak -> owner: TBD, due: next Tue
A3: observability dashboard + tagging -> owner: TBD, due: next Thu
A4: client-facing status note -> owner: PM, due: Mon
```

Omar S: I'll take A2 (autoscale). Target EOD Tue 2026-03-24. I'll open the infra PR and link it here.

Priya K: I'll own A3 (dashboards). Target Thu 2026-03-26. Need the runtime metric names from eng-runtime to finish panels.

Jin W: I'll do A4 (status note) — draft by Mon 2026-03-22 and will loop in comms for sign-off.

Maya L: Thanks. Omar — please paste the PR link when ready. Priya — whose reachable contact on runtime? @Omar S?

Omar S: @Priya K yep, that's me. I'll drop the metric list by EOD today.

SRE Bot: Reminder: INC-834 action items added to tracker: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-834/actions (automated entry)

Carmen P: I can pick up A1 (rollback safeguard) but need a minimal acceptance criteria set. Can someone paste it?

Maya L: Acceptance criteria: rollback endpoint that can be triggered with org flag; no DB migration required; automated smoke-check completes within 2 minutes. Minimal checklist:
- API endpoint + auth
- smoke test job that verifies basic flow
- runbook doc with rollback steps and post-rollback verification

Carmen P: OK taking A1. Due Fri 2026-03-27. Will create design doc and request review.

Priya K: small blocker — dashboard needs taggable spans emitted from runtime. If we can't get the tags in time I'll wire a temporary metric until run-time change lands. Will update by EOD.

Jin W: status note draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-834/status-draft — please add any customer-impact details.

Maya L: Canary plan: start throttled traffic to a single region, monitor p99/5m and error rate for 2h. If stable -> rollout. @Omar S to own canary execution and rollback window.

Omar S: Canary scheduled Tue 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC. I'll configure alerts (pager threshold + slack) and a 30m rollback decision window.

Maya L: If you own an item, reply with :thumbsup: and paste the tracker/PR/link + exact due date.

Omar S: :thumbsup: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/PR-482 due: 2026-03-24 EOD

Priya K: :thumbsup: tracker: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-834/actions#A3 due: 2026-03-26

Carmen P: :thumbsup: design: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-834/rollback-spec due: 2026-03-27

Jin W: :thumbsup: status note link above, aiming 2026-03-22 for draft

Maya L: Awesome. I'll do a Friday sweep to verify closure and move items to DONE in tracker. If anything slips earlier, ping this thread so we can adjust the canary window.

Priya K: noted — will post an update if runtime tagging is delayed.

Omar S: will confirm alerts are in place before the canary.

Maya L: Thanks all — appreciate the quick responses.
